title: Black & White Bedroom Finds
headline: Black & White Bedroom Ideas: 8 Amazon Finds for a Hotel-Style Bedroom
seo_title: Black and White Bedroom Ideas: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Black and white bedroom ideas from Amazon: a black canopy bed frame, hotel-white duvet, velvet bench, zebra rug, faux fur throw and more. Eight well-reviewed picks.
intro: A black canopy bed, crisp white linens, and one zebra rug that dares you to say it's too much. That's the bedroom. That's the whole thesis.

I built a black and white bedroom edit from Amazon, leaning on the pieces that carry the look: the bed, the bedding, the bench and the lighting. Every pick is rated 4.4 stars or higher with real review counts.
On the product pages, choose the black or white option I mention before you buy.
I haven't tested these. I'm telling you what's well reviewed and very hotel-suite. Let's go to bed in style.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: Queen Metal Canopy Bed Frame, Black
copy: A black four-poster metal canopy bed frame that makes the whole room look styled before you add a single pillow.
It rates 4.7 stars from more than 800 reviewers. Check the size and assembly notes on the page.
Verdict: the bed that is the look.

products.name: Luxury Queen Duvet Cover Set, White
products.best_for: The crisp white that makes the black pop
copy: A white duvet cover set that gives the hotel-bed look against all that black.
It has a 4.5-star rating from more than 3,100 reviewers.
Verdict: the simplest upgrade in the whole room.

products.name: Upholstered Storage Bench, 51 inch
products.best_for: The finishing touch at the foot of the bed
copy: An end-of-bed upholstered storage bench. It looks custom and hides the extra blankets.
It rates 4.7 stars from nearly 380 reviewers. Check the color options for black on the page.
Verdict: the detail that says someone planned this.

products.name: Black & Gold Touch Table Lamps, Set of 2, 22 inch
products.best_for: Warm light with a gold edge
copy: A matching pair of black-and-gold touch lamps, because two lamps is the fastest way to look intentional.
They have a 4.5-star rating from more than 1,500 reviewers.
Verdict: good bedside lighting you can tap on and off.

products.name: Faux Zebra Print Area Rug, 4'7" x 5'3"
copy: A faux zebra rug to anchor the bedside or sit under the bench.
It rates 4.5 stars from more than 10,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the bold touch that keeps it from being basic.

products.name: Bubble Faux Fur Throw Blanket, Black, 50 x 60
copy: A black faux fur throw to lay across white bedding so the whole bed looks layered.
It has a 4.6-star rating from nearly 3,500 reviewers.
Verdict: instant richness at the foot of the bed.

products.name: Black & Cream Striped Throw Pillow Covers, 20x20 (set of 2)
products.best_for: The cheap add-on that changes everything
copy: Black-and-cream striped pillow covers to stack in front of the white. Covers only, so grab inserts too.
They rate 4.5 stars from more than 2,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the budget move in a splurgy room.

products.name: Nightstand Set of 2 with Storage Drawers
copy: A pair of nightstands with drawers, so the lamps have somewhere to live. Choose the black option.
They have a 4.4-star rating from more than 1,300 reviewers.
Verdict: symmetry, but make it practical.

interludes.3: Rule one of the black and white bedroom: crisp white, always.
interludes.6: Rule two: one pattern, one texture, then stop.

outro: And that's the edit: eight Amazon finds for a black and white bedroom.
If you take one thing from this guide, start with the bedding and the lamps. They do the most for the least.
